description: Specifies whether or not the first row contains headers. Cannot be used when sorting PivotTable reports.

constants.name: xlGuess
constants.description: Excel determines whether there is a header, and where it is, if there is one.

constants.name: xlNo
constants.description: Default. The entire range should be sorted.

constants.name: xlYes
